description:
We are a team from Ogbomoso, Nigeria, building a tool that helps people check a piece of land before they build or rent there.

Many families in Nigeria buy land without knowing if it floods, if water is hard to find, or if a dumpsite, quarry or fuel depot nearby could affect their health. Our app uses NASA Earth data to show how a location has changed since 1981 (rainfall, heat, wetness and fires), whether those trends are significant, and what that means for the people who will live there.
